title: Move a TwiML app by changing the endpoint
alias: compat client on /api/laml/2010-04-01 + the same cXML handler
summary: A TwiML app moves to SignalWire by changing the REST base and the credentials. The compat client posts the same Calls body to the LaML path on your Space, and your cXML handler serves the same document it served before.
scenario: A shop's Twilio voice app, a Say and a Hangup behind one URL, moving without a rewrite

folds: sol: single highest-intent search with nothing for it
evidence: https://signalwire.com/docs/compatibility-api: update the base URL from api.twilio.com to your-space.signalwire.com; handlers work without modification (docs/enum/platform-docs.md D)
tools/openapi/compat.json POST /Accounts/{AccountSid}/Calls: To, From required; Url
